- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". ### 2. Dialect Implementations

Three SQL dialect implementations found in the store/db directory:

**PostgreSQL:** `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go` (lines 51-187)

**MySQL:** `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go` (lines 62-202)

- Similar query structure but with MySQL-specific timestamp functions (UNIX_TIMESTAMP, FROM_UNIXTIME)

**SQLite:** `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (lines 54-193)
